subject.title: refactor(plugins): read entry-scoped plugin config from api.pluginConfig

question: Does the repository want to retain `plugin-config-runtime` until 2026-10-30 on the stated external-plugin compatibility basis while adopting `api.pluginConfig` as the bundled-plugin canonical read path?
rationale: The branch changes the planned deprecation timing for a public installed-core SDK subpath; source-level tests can validate mechanics, but the acceptable compatibility window and permanent authoring guidance are maintainer policy choices.

options.title: Accept the staged demotion
options.body: Keep the public subpath through the proposed date, merge the bundled-plugin consolidation after runtime proof, and migrate external consumers when named replacements exist.

options.title: Keep the prior removal date
options.body: Do not extend the compatibility window and require a separately approved replacement or migration plan before changing bundled call sites.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Defer this consolidation until maintainers settle the external plugin SDK migration contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the staged demotion
recommendation.body: Keep the public subpath through the proposed date, merge the bundled-plugin consolidation after runtime proof, and migrate external consumers when named replacements exist.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author supplied the detailed compatibility inventory and implemented the affected plugin and compatibility-registry changes.
